health_small.source: Model 736 powerup_health_buff.adr (Models.txt); 15% from locale dev note 'combat - 15% health power up' (103703). Used automatically (client tutorial 388124). (R) small vs big share one model; pickup scale is reconstructed.

health_big.source: Model 736; 50% from locale dev note 'Heals 50% max hp, works across all tiers' (419605/419620); wiki: the big heart heals the whole group. (R) the 1.5 pickup scale.

energy.source: Model 737 powerup_mana_buff.adr; locale dev note 'Mana Power up. Heals 100 mana' (hash 1788006282). Used automatically.

flame_wave.source: Model 1949 powerup_flame_wave.adr; name 419611, icon 27632 (Images.txt); description 419615 says burn plus slow. (R) radius 10, 16 targets, burn tuning; damage_by_tier is the x1.75 weapon-tier curve (final-era balance); the slow half is not built yet.

earth_shard.source: Model 1950 powerup_quake.adr; name 419625, icon 27633; description 419624 'damaging opponents near you and stunning opponents around you'. (R) radius, 16 targets, 2.5 s stun ('briefly'), damage curve.

super_shield.source: Model 1951 powerup_super_shield.adr; name 103799; description 103800 'prevents you from being hurt and increases your run speed for a few seconds'. (R) 5 s and +30% speed; mesh and icon are missing from the extracted pack set.

standard.source: (R) Chances and weights are reconstructed: no source holds them (the original 'standard weights' lived on the server). Two independent rolls mirror the two reactive procs 420826/420828.

elite.source: (R) Tougher enemies drop more often; chances and weights are reconstructed.

boss.source: (R) Bosses always drop a big heart (locale 'garunteed to drop a power up'); the choice of kind is reconstructed.

participation.source: (R) the owner 2026-10-16: every player who took part in a kill rolls and gets their own pickup. Took part = dealt damage within window_ms, or was the enemy's target. Lower group_chance_multiplier (0.05..1) to thin the roll chances when two or more share a kill.

pickup.source: (R) 30 s despawn so actors cannot pile up, 1.5 m walk-over radius, 16 alive per instance.
